sessionGrant.description: the agent answers the session-grant flow (section 4.1, PROF-DESC-004)

flows.description: the agent opens flows through the flow profile (PROF-DESC-004)

peerStatus.description: the agent tells a wallet where it stands with peer-status/1.0/status; a wallet asks for a session grant once a status lists ag-ui as open (PROF-DESC-007)

tools.description: the agent serves the tools of a space (section 3.10), the confirmation card of a tool call and the sources of replies and conversations (3.4, PROF-DESC-009)

connections.description: the agent serves each person's own accounts: Your accounts (section 3.11), ayni.connections.changed, the Connect card and the kind of account personal (3.5, PROF-DESC-010)

notifications.description: the agent serves the Notifications of a space and of the agent: the lists of section 3.12, ayni.space.notifications.changed and notificationsWaiting on a space (3.5 amended, agent D114, PROF-DESC-011)

visitors.description: the agent lets a person in without authenticating, as a visitor: no authentication schema, or one that lets visitors in (3.5.2, agent IDENT-RES-007, IDENT-RES-010, PROF-DESC-012)

erasure.description: a Principal deletes a message they wrote, with the agent's reply, while it is younger than windowSeconds (3.3, PROF-DESC-008)
